query.combat.guide.title: Combat rewards · Guide
query.combat.guide.usage: Set the combat range and matching mode separately for cards and potions. Specific combats assigns targets to combat numbers. Any combat in range assigns each target to a different combat, including repeated targets. Cards and potions match independently; equal target numbers need not occur in the same combat. Empty card slots impose no requirement. Card targets check identities offered in rewards.
query.combat.guide.legality: Reward filters include the specified opening’s effects. Any consumption of the Rewards RNG stream at a node other than a normal combat, or extra consumption during combat, affects subsequent results. See the encyclopedia for normal-combat effects that consume this stream.

query.shop.guide.title: Shop · Guide
query.shop.guide.usage:
Each block has its own visit range (first 3 by default) and specific-shop mode. Specific shops assigns targets to exact visit numbers within that block.
Shop numbers count actual visits to normal shops; skipped shops do not count. Set the visit range, then choose targets. Enable “Specific shops” for a row to match visit numbers; empty slots are unrestricted. Otherwise, targets may appear anywhere in range, and repeated targets require separate stock positions. Rows match independently: a relic and colorless card in the same column need not come from the same shop.
The relic row targets shop-exclusive relics in the third slot. Colorless cards use initial stock generated over consecutive visits. Courier restocks, Fake Merchant and similar extra consumption can shift later results; these effects are not modeled.
query.relic.guide.title: Relic sequences · Guide
query.relic.guide.usage:
Select a relic to identify its personal sequence. Each condition defaults to the first 3 positions and has its own range. Advanced controls allow an exact position or exclusion; collapsing them keeps conditions active.
Positions are not actual pickups or shop visits. Earlier draws from the relevant sequence advance it. Shared chest bags are outside this page.
query.ancient.guide.title: Ancients · Guide
query.ancient.guide.usage: The default mode selects one Ancient and one option for each of Acts 2 and 3. In advanced mode, “Any offered option” accepts any selected target; “Offered option group” requires all targets in one offer, without requiring you to take them all. Each mode saves its own conditions; search uses the active mode.
query.ancient.guide.multiplayer: In multiplayer, each Act's Ancient identity is shared: changing it on any player page updates everyone. Advanced is also a party-wide toggle; each player keeps their own option requirement type and targets.
query.ancient.guide.premise: “Adjust option eligibility” describes your deck and holdings on arrival: lit means met, dim means unmet. An option's eligibility can change other offers even when you do not target that relic. Search checks the Ancient and offered options; it does not plan how to reach those conditions or simulate every random effect after taking an option.
query.ancient.party.title: Shared Acts 2–3 identities · P{0} options
query.ancient.party.group_requires_one: Narrow the shared Ancient identity to one before requiring an offered option group.
query.event.guide.title: Events · Guide
query.event.guide.usage:
Choose an act and range, then add events. By default, new conditions use First N · Appears; advanced settings allow exact positions or exclusions. Returning to simple mode affects only future additions and retains existing advanced conditions. Included events can expand to show result targets. Multiple queue conditions for one event share the same result requirements, without adding random attempts. In solo play, transform events can also contribute to the combined transform target.
Transform targets require keeping starter cards and taking the corresponding branch. Targets describe the generated card identities; two-card targets are unordered.
query.event.guide.boundary: First N or Nth refers to candidate positions after filtering by act and static eligibility, rather than question-mark rooms or events actually encountered. Gold, deck and other conditions on arrival may still make the game skip a candidate. Results are checked for the selected branch; queue conditions do not arrange a route that completes those events.

query.act_info.guide.title: Act information · Guide
query.act_info.guide.usage: Choose a map scope and the route objective you want to find. For a single Act, Advanced map feature filters can further describe the map.
query.act_info.guide.boundary: Whole run filters an overall route objective; map features describe one Act. Multiple route objectives cannot be combined into a same-path search.
query.act_info.identity.guide.title: Boss / Variant · Guide
query.act_info.identity.guide.usage: Choose the Bosses and map variants you want. Nothing is restricted by default; after selecting one or more options, only those results pass.
query.act_info.identity.guide.boundary: Multiple selections use OR semantics. With no selection, no corresponding condition is added.
query.map.guide.title: Map nodes · Guide
query.map.guide.usage: Set a route target for a scope to find a path through at least the requested number of one node type. Whole-run targets sum the three act maxima and are mutually exclusive with per-act route targets. For an individual act, add map properties, then edit their dropdown values or remove them.
query.map.guide.boundary: A route target checks whether a path meeting the count exists. Additional properties are independent and may be reached by different paths; matching them alongside a route target does not mean one path satisfies them all. Map filtering does not settle events, rewards or combat outcomes along the route.
